Let me view reference images one at a time, starting with Bacterial_Pustule.
This Frogeye_leaf_spot reference closely matches the test image - small circular spots on green leaf held in hand. Let me check a few more classes.

I've now viewed references from 16 different classes. Summary of findings:

- **Frogeye_leaf_spot** (Soybean_Dise_6.jpg): Strongest match — green leaf held in hand, small circular spots with dark borders, some with centers dropped out (shot-hole), identical presentation to test image.
- All other classes showed clearly different symptoms: stem rot, seed staining, large lesions, field-level yellowing, whole plant damage, etc.

The test image shows a green soybean leaf held in hand with small, discrete circular spots having dark centers and slightly lighter borders — classic frogeye leaf spot presentation.
